# That One UI

https://that-one-ui.vercel.app

That One UI is a copy-paste React component library on Base UI primitives.
Every component ships as one self-contained file (`Component.tsx`) with a
`styles/default.ts` file next to it. There is no separate preview file —
`Component.tsx` is both the installable component and what renders in every
preview surface on the site.

## The styleConfig contract

1. Every prop that renders inside a component has a default value. Nothing is
   hardcoded — a consumer can always override any string, number, array, or
   node the component renders.
2. A component accepts an optional `styleConfig` prop. Swapping it changes
   Tailwind classes ONLY — colors, borders, shadows, radius. It never changes
   the prop shape, defaults, or behavior. The full prop API is identical
   regardless of which style is imported.
3. Types shared between the component and its style file (e.g. a variant
   union) are defined in `styles/default.ts` and re-exported from
   `Component.tsx`.

To install a component: copy `Component.tsx` and `styles/default.ts` (and any
other style file you want) into your project. No other setup is required
beyond the Tailwind + Base UI primitives already listed in the component's
imports.

## 38 components across 4 categories, 8 available styles

Available styles: default, glass, minimal, neobrutalism, neumorphism, gradient, retro, terminal.

## Components

### inputs

- Button (`button`, inputs): 6 variants · 3 sizes · 3 shapes · disabled + loading states. Built on Base UI's Button primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/button/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=button&category=inputs
- Checkbox (`checkbox`, inputs): An accessible checkbox with emerald checked state and optional label. Built on Base UI's Checkbox primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/checkbox/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=checkbox&category=inputs
- Input (`input`, inputs): A dark text input with inset shadow, emerald focus ring, and full disabled/read-only state support.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/input/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=input&category=inputs
- Radio Group (`radio-group`, inputs): An accessible radio group using Base UI Radio + RadioGroup primitives. Emerald accent on selection.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/radio-group/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=radio-group&category=inputs
- Select (`select`, inputs): A dark dropdown select with glass-effect popup, highlighted states, and a check mark on the selected item.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/select/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=select&category=inputs
- Slider (`slider`, inputs): A range slider with emerald fill track and a thumb that grows on active. Built on Base UI's Slider primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/slider/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=slider&category=inputs
- Switch (`switch`, inputs): A toggle switch that transitions to emerald when active. Thumb translates smoothly on state change.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/switch/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=switch&category=inputs
- Textarea (`textarea`, inputs): Multi-line text input with label, description, error/helper text, resize control, size variants, and a loading overlay.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/textarea/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=textarea&category=inputs
- Radio (`radio`, inputs): A single radio button with optional label and description. Built on Base UI's Radio primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/radio/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=radio&category=inputs
- Combobox (`combobox`, inputs): A searchable selection input with multi-select, chip display, clear button, and loading state. Built on Base UI Combobox.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/combobox/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=combobox&category=inputs
- Date Picker (`date-picker`, inputs): A date selection input with a calendar popup. Supports single, range, and multi-date selection with min/max constraints.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/date-picker/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=date-picker&category=inputs
- Field (`field`, inputs): A form field wrapper providing label, description, and error with accessibility linking. Built on Base UI's Field primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/field/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=field&category=inputs

### data-display

- Avatar (`avatar`, data-display): Avatar with image support, text fallback, shape, size, and status dot. Built on Base UI's Avatar primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/avatar/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=avatar&category=data-display
- Separator (`separator`, data-display): A thin 1px rule that divides content. Horizontal (default) splits stacked sections; vertical splits inline items such as nav links.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/separator/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=separator&category=data-display
- Tabs (`tabs`, data-display): Tab bar with a sliding emerald underline indicator. Panels swap on selection.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/tabs/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=tabs&category=data-display
- Progress (`progress`, data-display): A linear progress bar with optional label and value display. Emerald fill, zinc-800 track.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/progress/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=progress&category=data-display
- Accordion (`accordion`, data-display): Collapsible panels with a chevron indicator that rotates on open. Divided by zinc-800 rules.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/accordion/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=accordion&category=data-display
- Tooltip (`tooltip`, data-display): A dark glass tooltip anchored to its trigger with configurable side placement.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/tooltip/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=tooltip&category=data-display
- Card (`card`, data-display): A flexible surface container for grouping related content. Supports bordered and hoverable variants.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/card/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=card&category=data-display
- Badge (`badge`, data-display): A compact label for status indicators, counts, or metadata. Supports solid, soft, and outline styles across six colors.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/badge/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=badge&category=data-display
- Chip (`chip`, data-display): An interactive filter or selection token. Supports selected state and a removable dismiss button.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/chip/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=chip&category=data-display
- Table (`table`, data-display): A basic data table with local sorting, row selection, loading skeletons, and empty state support.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/table/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=table&category=data-display
- Data Table (`data-table`, data-display): Advanced table with search, sorting, pagination, column visibility toggle, and row selection — all in one component.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/data-table/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=data-table&category=data-display
- Empty (`empty`, data-display): An empty state panel with an icon, title, description, and optional action buttons.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/empty/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=empty&category=data-display

### feedback

  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/dialog/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=dialog&category=feedback

  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/popover/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=popover&category=feedback
- Alert (`alert`, feedback): An inline status message in four severity levels: info, success, warning, and error. Optionally dismissible.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/alert/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=alert&category=feedback
- Toast (`toast`, feedback): Transient notifications that slide in from the corner. Uses Base UI Toast with a global toastManager for triggering outside React.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/toast/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=toast&category=feedback
- Dropdown Menu (`dropdown-menu`, feedback): A keyboard-navigable dropdown menu with icons, keyboard shortcuts, separators, and a danger style. Built on Base UI Menu primitive.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/dropdown-menu/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=dropdown-menu&category=feedback
- Alert Dialog (`alert-dialog`, feedback): A blocking confirmation dialog. Supports destructive mode, loading state on the confirm button, and size variants.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/alert-dialog/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=alert-dialog&category=feedback
- Sonner (`sonner`, feedback): A toast notification system with type variants, position control, action buttons, and dismiss support. Built on Base UI Toast.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/sonner/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=sonner&category=feedback
- Spinner (`spinner`, feedback): A circular loading indicator in five sizes. Disappears when loading is false.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/spinner/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=spinner&category=feedback
- Drawer (`drawer`, feedback): A swipe-dismissible temporary side or bottom panel with title, description, and loading state. Built on Base UI Drawer.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/drawer/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=drawer&category=feedback
- Sheet (`sheet`, feedback): A persistent side panel that slides in from any edge. Unlike Drawer, it uses the Dialog primitive — no swipe dismiss.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/sheet/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=sheet&category=feedback

### navigation

- Sidebar (`sidebar`, navigation): An application navigation sidebar with collapse support, nested items, badges, and active state tracking.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/sidebar/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=sidebar&category=navigation
- Breadcrumb (`breadcrumb`, navigation): A page hierarchy trail with configurable separator, ellipsis truncation for long paths, and aria-current on the last item.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/breadcrumb/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=breadcrumb&category=navigation
- Command (`command`, navigation): A keyboard-driven command palette with grouped commands, fuzzy search, arrow-key navigation, and a global ⌘K shortcut.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/command/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=command&category=navigation
- Pagination (`pagination`, navigation): A page navigation control with smart ellipsis, first/last shortcuts, and size variants. Controlled and uncontrolled.
  page: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/components/pagination/default
  source: https://that-one-ui.vercel.app/api/design-code?slug=pagination&category=navigation
